name: logo-sting
title: Logo sting
summary: A 2-to-10-second logo animation with a designed sound: the mark builds from its parts, resolves on the lockup and holds.
use_when: An opener or closer for other films, a channel bumper, or the end of an ad.

1:1.note: Not LinkedIn: its videos run 3 seconds or more, and a sting can be shorter.

pace.note: Usually no voice; a spoken tagline, if there is one, stays under the ceiling.

beats.name: build
beats.job: The mark assembles from its parts, following the brand's logo-build spec.

beats.name: resolve
beats.job: It lands on the lockup, with the sound's accent on the landing frame.

beats.name: hold
beats.job: The lockup holds, still and legible, for at least 1.5 seconds.

rules: The motion is the brand's signature motion from its pack, not a stock reveal.
The sound's accent lands within a frame of the resolve.
End on a clean frame that can cut to black or straight into a film.

loudness.note: Measured over a few seconds, integrated loudness is a rough guide; the sting should sit level with the film it opens or closes.

captions.note: No speech by default. A spoken tagline gets captions like any line.

budget.note: A sting rarely speaks; its sound is designed from the brand's palette, or a short score take.

notes: Built from the brand pack's logos (SVG) and logo-build spec; the kit's logo build and sting components do the work.
The end hold is the hold beat's own 1.5 s (qa's end_hold): the films' 3 s end card would be most of a 5-second sting and longer than a 2-second one.
